title: Go inference runtimes on GitHub
bounded_meaning: A source-addressable inventory of reusable repositories with substantive Go code that execute neural-model inference, govern a local native inference backend, or expose an embeddable Go inference framework. It is not a ranking, benchmark, or census of every application that calls an inference API.

tiers.native-go-engine: Model or tensor execution materially runs as Go code. Generated or translated provenance is called out separately.
tiers.go-governed-native-backend: Go owns loading, lifecycle, scheduling, or serving while a declared native backend owns tensor computation.
tiers.go-binding-framework: An embeddable Go API, importer, or pipeline framework delegates some or all execution to a selectable or foreign backend.
tiers.research-demo: A reproducible model-specific implementation intended primarily as an educational or narrow reference.

inclusion_criteria: Substantive Go code owns model/tensor execution, local runtime governance, or an embeddable inference API.
At least one pinned implementation or test anchor proves the execution boundary.
The repository is reusable beyond one downstream application, except for representative research demos.
exclusion_criteria: Thin remote API clients, agent/RAG frameworks, gateways, and Kubernetes operators with no local model execution.
Model download, tokenizer, format, or vector-search packages that own no reusable execution path.
Downstream applications embedding one fixed model and duplicate forks that add no execution-boundary distinction.
Unlicensed code is discovery-only and DO-NOT-USE.

fak_witness.index_queries: fak-dev index docs|leaves|verbs|claims "Go inference runtime" returned adjacent inference material but no dedicated runtime inventory
fak_witness.raw_search: Repository grep found Ollama and LocalAI mentions but no source-pinned Go-runtime corpus
fak_witness.resolution: This inventory is the shipped documentation spine tracked by issue #9846.

runtimes.go_owns: model graph definitions, runner selection, cache policy, product API and orchestration
runtimes.compute_boundary: Go-authored graphs execute through dynamically loaded MLX; a separate path still invokes llama.cpp. This is hybrid execution, not pure-Go tensor math.
runtimes.scope: GGUF/local generative serving; broad Llama, Qwen, Gemma, GLM, Cohere, Nemotron and related model families; CPU and accelerators through MLX/llama.cpp builds.
runtimes.worldview: Consumer-grade compatibility and UX with Go owning the architecture layer; kernel ownership is traded for mature foreign backends.

runtimes.activity: active; default branch advanced after the study cutoff
runtimes.go_owns: OpenAI-compatible APIs, configuration, backend selection, model lifecycle, coalescing, RPC and process supervision
runtimes.compute_boundary: Inference runs in selected C++, Rust, Python, remote, or native-library backend workers.
runtimes.scope: Text, embeddings, rerank, vision, speech/TTS, image and video across CPU, CUDA, ROCm, Metal and Vulkan according to backend.
runtimes.worldview: Maximize model and deployment coverage through interchangeable workers; excellent control-plane precedent without kernel ownership.

runtimes.go_owns: SDK/server APIs, model lifecycle, batching, admission, queueing and output assembly
runtimes.compute_boundary: Yzma/llama.cpp, bucky/whisper.cpp and malina/stable-diffusion.cpp own computation.
runtimes.scope: GGUF LLM/chat, embeddings, rerank, VLM, transcription and diffusion on backend-supported hardware.
runtimes.worldview: A cohesive embeddable Go runtime over specialized native engines; direct-library governance without owning kernels.

runtimes.go_owns: LLaMA graph, tensor/autograd runtime, CPU kernels and WebGPU/WGSL backend
runtimes.compute_boundary: CPU execution is Go/assembly; GPU execution uses Go-owned WGSL through WebGPU driver bindings.
runtimes.scope: GGUF, SafeTensors and partial ONNX; LLaMA and general ML graphs; CPU and WebGPU.
runtimes.worldview: One idiomatic Go training-and-inference stack with portable GPU APIs; model breadth and operational maturity remain young.

runtimes.go_owns: decoder loop, GGUF/SafeTensors loading, quantization, backend admission and serving
runtimes.compute_boundary: Go CPU path plus optional cgo-free CUDA driver/PTX, Metal/purego and WebGPU paths.
runtimes.scope: Broad decoder-only Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Mistral, Phi, DeepSeek, GLM, MoE and recurrent-hybrid families.
runtimes.worldview: Own kernels, formats, quantization and fallback in one static binary; very broad maintenance burden with tiny adoption so far.

runtimes.go_owns: encoder, pooling, attention and Go/assembly SIMD tensor kernels
runtimes.compute_boundary: CPU-only native Go/assembly execution.
runtimes.scope: SafeTensors/Hugging Face embedding models including BERT, RoBERTa, MPNet, ModernBERT, Nomic and Qwen3 embedding families.
runtimes.worldview: Embedding-only correctness and a small dependency surface instead of generation or accelerator breadth.

runtimes.go_owns: GGUF parsing, quantized CPU operations and model forward paths
runtimes.compute_boundary: CPU is pure Go; optional CUDA path uses CGo and is outside the native-Go boundary.
runtimes.scope: GGUF Llama, Qwen3, Mistral, Gemma, Phi and DeepSeek with Q2-Q8 quantization families.
runtimes.worldview: Direct GGUF breadth in Go; very early history and a CGo accelerator compromise limit confidence.

runtimes.license: BSD-2-Clause with separately licensed assembly subtrees
runtimes.go_owns: tensor, autograd, neural layers, serialization and CPU/assembly execution
runtimes.compute_boundary: Self-contained CPU Go/assembly; pretrained transformer applications moved to Cybertron.
runtimes.scope: Custom attention, recurrent, convolution, gMLP/MLP-Mixer and NLP models; no turnkey GGUF/HF LLM serving.
runtimes.worldview: Standalone comprehensible Go ML/NLP binaries over accelerator and pretrained-model breadth.

runtimes.go_owns: symbolic graph compiler, VMs and tensor execution
runtimes.compute_boundary: CPU uses Go tensor/BLAS paths; optional NVIDIA path uses project CUDA/cuDNN/cuBLAS integration.
runtimes.scope: Custom differentiable graphs and vision/NLP examples; no modern first-class pretrained LLM format loader.
runtimes.worldview: Inspectability through an explicit graph compiler and VM, at the cost of pretrained-model interoperability and ceremony.

runtimes.go_owns: GGUF loading, model graphs, generation, serving, CPU kernels and accelerator orchestration
runtimes.compute_boundary: Go CPU path plus owned CUDA and Metal source; broad claims lack independent operating-envelope witnesses.
runtimes.scope: GGUF/Hugging Face plus LLM, multimodal, audio, tabular and time-series model families.
runtimes.worldview: Aggressively broad zero-CGo Go deployment; feature velocity and tiny adoption create a high verification burden.

runtimes.go_owns: static runtime API, instances, contexts and translated call table
runtimes.compute_boundary: llama.cpp is compiled to Wasm and translated/generated into Go; no CGo or Wasm runtime remains, but implementation provenance is C++ rather than Go-authored kernels.
runtimes.scope: Pinned llama.cpp GGUF model envelope; CPU-only translated execution and a 4 GiB wasm32 memory boundary.
runtimes.worldview: Static Go deployment everywhere Go runs, accepting Wasm memory/performance constraints and generated C++ provenance.

runtimes.go_owns: graph construction, execution caching, model APIs, generation and quantization decomposition
runtimes.compute_boundary: Selectable companion backends: portable pure-Go execution, OpenXLA/PJRT or ONNX Runtime.
runtimes.scope: Custom GoMLX graphs, Hugging Face formats and optional ONNX; CPU/WASM, XLA CPU/CUDA/TPU and provider-specific paths.
runtimes.worldview: Composable Go model authoring with replaceable execution engines; portability and peak performance are separate backend choices.

runtimes.go_owns: transformer pipelines, tokenization flow, model reuse and backend selection
runtimes.compute_boundary: ORT mode uses native ONNX Runtime, XLA mode uses native XLA, and GoMLX-go mode executes supported operators in Go.
runtimes.scope: Classification, embeddings, zero-shot, QA, detection, tabular and text-generation pipelines; hardware depends on backend.
runtimes.worldview: Hugging Face-like ergonomics with backend interchangeability; model support and parity must be judged per execution route.

runtimes.license: MIT wrapper plus external ONNX Runtime provenance
runtimes.go_owns: typed tensors, session configuration, lifetimes and API ergonomics
runtimes.compute_boundary: A CGo shim dynamically loads ONNX Runtime; ORT owns graph planning and computation.
runtimes.scope: General ONNX graphs, dynamic shapes/types and LoRA; providers depend on the external ORT build.
runtimes.worldview: Direct coverage of ORT's stable C ABI; broad portability while execution ownership remains native ORT.

runtimes.license: Apache-2.0 wrapper plus external libtorch provenance
runtimes.go_owns: idiomatic model and tensor API plus lifecycle wrappers
runtimes.compute_boundary: CGo enters libtorch; PyTorch C++ owns all tensor and model computation.
runtimes.scope: TorchScript/PyTorch models, vision models and companion transformer package; CPU and CUDA.
runtimes.worldview: Inherit PyTorch's model breadth and kernels rather than rebuild them, accepting CGo and native ABI burden.

runtimes.go_owns: ONNX protobuf decoding and graph translation
runtimes.compute_boundary: A pluggable computation backend performs execution; the common included adapter is Gorgonia.
runtimes.scope: ONNX import with operator and hardware coverage inherited from the selected backend.
runtimes.worldview: Decouple a portable model format from execution; backend choice also imports backend operator gaps.

runtimes.license: Apache-2.0 plus MIT portions and external llama.cpp provenance
runtimes.go_owns: generated bindings, handles, callbacks, ABI validation and VLM helpers
runtimes.compute_boundary: purego dynamically loads llama/ggml/mtmd libraries; llama.cpp owns model load and computation. No CGo does not mean native-Go compute.
runtimes.scope: llama.cpp GGUF LLM, embeddings, rerank and multimodal surface; hardware follows the loaded native library.
runtimes.worldview: Remove CGo build friction while exposing a rapidly changing native API; ABI drift becomes the main failure mode.

runtimes.license: MIT binding plus pinned llama.cpp provenance
runtimes.go_owns: coarse public API and option marshaling
runtimes.compute_boundary: CGo enters binding C++; pinned llama.cpp performs loading, tokenization, embeddings and decode.
runtimes.scope: GGUF and the hardware/model envelope of an older pinned llama.cpp snapshot.
runtimes.worldview: Reduce CGo crossings through high-level calls; API simplicity is coupled to a stale native snapshot.

runtimes.license: mixed MIT root and Apache-2.0 file headers plus external ORT provenance
runtimes.go_owns: versioned APIs, typed wrappers, multi-runtime isolation and lifetimes
runtimes.compute_boundary: purego uses dlopen/dlsym; native ONNX Runtime and ORT GenAI own computation.
runtimes.scope: General ONNX sessions and ORT GenAI; provider/hardware coverage follows loaded native libraries.
runtimes.worldview: Avoid CGo and support multiple ORT versions, with very small adoption and unresolved file-level licensing signals.

runtimes.go_owns: generated declarations, registration, handles and FFI fallbacks
runtimes.compute_boundary: purego dynamically resolves llama/ggml libraries; native llama.cpp owns all tensor/decode compute.
runtimes.scope: llama.cpp GGUF models and hardware supported by the loaded library.
runtimes.worldview: Generated no-CGo bindings minimize toolchain friction but stay pinned to a moving native ABI; Yzma is the stronger current descendant.

runtimes.go_owns: float32 Llama-2 checkpoint reader, tokenizer, KV state and forward loop
runtimes.compute_boundary: Pure-Go CPU; no GPU or general model-format layer.
runtimes.scope: Llama-2/llama2.c checkpoints only.
runtimes.worldview: A faithful inspectable Go translation of llama2.c for study rather than a general runtime.

runtimes.go_owns: official-weight loading, tokenizer, transformer forward and generation
runtimes.compute_boundary: Pure-Go CPU/goroutine implementation; intentionally no GPU or SIMD.
runtimes.scope: Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct from official PyTorch Pickle weights.

runtimes.scope: Narrow Llama-family GGUF support.
runtimes.worldview: An embeddable package-oriented native-Go experiment; absent licensing blocks reuse.

Downstream inference product/tooling rather than a reusable runtime or binding.
Docker product/service orchestration, not an embeddable Go inference runtime.

Model library over Gotch/libtorch; counted with Gotch.

covered_families: ONNX Runtime CGo and purego binding styles
llama.cpp CGo, purego and translated-to-Go styles

known_limits: GitHub repository search is text- and primary-language-dependent and can miss Go subtrees in non-Go-primary monorepos.
Star counts and branch activity are discovery metadata, not quality or performance evidence.
No runtime was benchmarked; model-support and performance claims remain source claims unless separately witnessed.
Application-specific ONNX/TFLite consumers are intentionally not enumerated.
A moving default branch must be re-pinned before implementation or comparison work.
completeness.critic_result: No material execution-boundary family remained unopened. Remaining candidates were duplicate provenance families, downstream applications, companion modules, narrow consumers, or unlicensed experiments.
